title: Before the Tool Call: Deterministic Pre-Action Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
snippet: Characterizes the pre-action authorization problem: agents execute tool calls (fund transfers, DB queries, shell commands, sub-agent delegation) with no standard mechanism to enforce authorization before execution. Presents Open Agent Passport (OAP), an open spec and reference implementation that intercepts tool calls synchronously before execution, evaluates them against a declarative policy, and produces a cryptographically signed audit record. Median enforcement latency 53 ms (N=1,000); evaluated on a live adversarial testbed with 4,437 decisions across 1,151 sessions.

title: MCP authorization – agentgateway
snippet: agentgateway's MCP authorization policy runs in the context of an MCP request: rules are CEL expressions evaluated against method invocations such as list_tools and call_tools to control which tools, prompts, and resources a client may access. Unauthorized tools are filtered from list responses, and a handcrafted call to a hidden tool is still rejected with an authorization error. Companion walkthrough: learncloudnative.com '7 practical MCP policies with agentgateway' (2026-08-14).

title: Top 5 Agentic Gateways for Securing MCP Tool Calls in 2026 | Pomerium
snippet: Surveys five agentic gateways that sit between agents and MCP servers to enforce authentication, authorization, and audit on every tool call, distinguishing gateways that treat MCP as a generic API from those doing session-aware, tool-level policy enforcement. Cites 1,862 internet-exposed MCP servers with zero auth. Highlights Pomerium's mcp_tool criterion for per-tool allow/deny on every request and Kong Konnect's MCP Registry (Feb 2026).

title: CONTINUITY: Security-Context Contracts for Composable LLM Agent Controls
snippet: arXiv paper modeling each agent-control component with an assume-guarantee contract and requiring every realized external effect to be backed by a valid authorization witness; a deployment closure obligation requires every path to pass through a registered adapter or a tool-native verifier with equivalent enforcement.
